Archival Dispatch: 29 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Air Adventures of Jimmie Allen, Firefighters, Smiley Burnette, and Ave Maria Hour

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min

Batch 33 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 33 resolves 29 action, drama, western music, and sacred drama master radio recordings: 6 aerial dogfight and espionage episodes from The Air Adventures of Jimmie Allen (1936–1937), 8 five-alarm emergency drama broadcasts from Firefighters (Summer 1955), 7 transcribed western swing musical episodes from The Smiley Burnette Show (Spring 1947), and 8 dramatic religious master discs from the Franciscan Friars of the Atonement's The Ave Maria Hour (1948–1954).

1. Air Adventures of Jimmie Allen — 1936–1937 Aviation Master Transcriptions

Starring Jimmie Allen and Speed Robertson in aerial stunt work and espionage pursuit:
